chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Mahziyar who said:

I saw Abu Ja'far al-Thani (peace be upon him) on the night of the visitation performing the Tawaf of the women, and he prayed behind the Maqam. Then he entered Zamzam, drew water from it with his hand using the bucket that is next to the Stone, drank from it, and poured some upon his body. Then he looked into Zamzam twice. And one of our companions informed me that he saw him, a year after that, doing the same.

key_terms.طَوَافَ النِّسَاءِ: Tawaf of the women (a specific type of circumambulation)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) do with the water of Zamzam during Hajj?
ai.summary: This narration from *Al-Kafi* highlights the ritual precision of Imam al-Sadiq (AS) during Hajj, specifically his performance of *Tawaf al-Nisa'* (women's Tawaf) and his unique practice of drinking and pouring Zamzam water while standing in the well. This serves as a key juristic precedent (*hujjah*) in Shia fiqh for the permissibility of these acts, illustrating the Imams' adherence to and elaboration upon Prophetic traditions. The detailed description of using the specific bucket near the Black Stone underscores the importance of following the exact manner (*kayfiyyah*) prescribed by the Ahl al-Bayt.
